abydos-dendera-tour.section:
Two temples, one day north of Luxor

Abydos was ancient Egypt’s holiest burial ground, the home of Osiris. The Temple of Seti I, built around 1290 BC, holds reliefs so finely cut they still look fresh, and the Abydos King List, a wall naming seventy-six pharaohs in order. Look up for the so-called helicopter hieroglyphs, a re-carved royal title that has fuelled theories for decades. Behind the temple, the sunken granite Osireion often stands in groundwater.

Dendera is one of the most complete temples in Egypt, sacred to Hathor, goddess of love, music and joy. Its restored ceilings glow in their original blues. Climb to the roof chapels for the cast of the Dendera zodiac (the original is in the Louvre), and walk to the rear wall to find Cleopatra VII with her son Caesarion. If the crypts are open, look for the reliefs nicknamed the Dendera light.

How the day flows

  1. Early pickup from your villa or hotel in Luxor.
  2. North along the Nile valley: Dendera is about an hour away, Abydos about three.
  3. Time inside each temple at your own pace, with a guide if you add one.
  4. Back in Luxor by evening.

Good to know

  • Bring a hat and comfortable shoes; the Dendera roof and temple courts are open to the sun.
  • A phone torch helps in the darker halls.
  • Pair it with an easy villa day afterwards, or end the evening on a sunset Nile cruise another day.
faqs: How far are Abydos and Dendera from Luxor?
Dendera is about an hour’s drive north of Luxor, near Qena. Abydos is farther, roughly three hours away, which is why this is a full-day tour.
Abydos or Dendera: which is better?

They are different. Abydos has the finest carved reliefs and the King List; Dendera has the most complete temple, with painted ceilings and rooftop chapels. Seeing both in one day is the point of this trip.

abu-simbel-tour.section:
Ramesses II at the edge of Egypt

Abu Simbel stands on the shore of Lake Nasser, close to the Sudanese border. Four seated colossi of Ramesses II, each about 20 metres tall, guard the Great Temple, cut straight into the sandstone cliff in the thirteenth century BC. Beside it, the smaller temple honours Queen Nefertari and Hathor, and the queen’s statues stand as tall as the king’s.

In the 1960s the rising waters of the Aswan High Dam threatened both temples. A UNESCO campaign cut them into more than a thousand blocks and rebuilt them about 65 metres higher. Twice a year, around 22 February and 22 October, the rising sun still reaches the inner sanctuary and lights three of its four seated gods; Ptah, god of the underworld, stays in shadow.

How the day flows

  1. Very early pickup in Luxor for the long drive south.
  2. The road passes Aswan, then crosses the Nubian desert to Lake Nasser.
  3. Time inside both temples and on the lakeshore.
  4. The drive back to Luxor the same evening.

Good to know

  • Desert mornings can be cool in winter; bring a light layer for the early start.
  • Both temples share one site and are visited together.
  • Prefer a shorter day south? The Aswan & Philae tour covers Edfu, the High Dam and the island Temple of Isis.
faqs: Can I see the Abu Simbel sun festival on this tour?
The sun reaches the sanctuary at sunrise around 22 February and 22 October, and those mornings draw large crowds. Message us before booking either date so we can talk through timing.
Is the Temple of Nefertari included?
Yes. The Great Temple and the Temple of Nefertari stand side by side and are visited together. Entrance tickets are paid at the site.

sunset-nile-boat-cruise.section:
Luxor from the water

Out on the river, Luxor slows down. Palm groves and villages line the West Bank, white sails cross the current, and the sun drops behind the Theban hills. Dinner is served on board as the sky turns from gold to violet, then tea and coffee under the first stars.

How the evening flows

  1. Private pickup from your villa or hotel, timed to the season’s sunset.
  2. Board and cast off as the light turns golden.
  3. About two hours on the Nile, with an Egyptian dinner, tea and coffee.
  4. Private transfer back to your door.

Good to know

  • Evenings on the water are cool in winter; bring a light layer from November to February.
  • Tell us about dietary needs when you enquire.
  • It is a natural finish to a temple day: pair it with the Karnak & Luxor Temple tour or a sunrise balloon flight for a day that starts and ends above the Nile.
faqs: What time does the sunset cruise start?
It is timed to sunset, so pickup moves with the season. We confirm your exact pickup time on WhatsApp when you book.
